blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: This product is intended for healthy individuals 18 years and older. Do not consume if you are pregnant or nursing or have a medical condition. Consult your healthcare provider before taking this product. Do not purchase if the outer seal is broken or damaged. Do not exceed recommended dose. Keep out of reach of children.
CA warning: This product can expose you to chemicals including Lead, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm. Prop 65.
